data.answer: Dubai Umm Ramool is a thriving mixed-use community strategically located near Dubai International Airport and Dubai Festival City. The area offers both residential and commercial spaces, making it an ideal location for working professionals, especially those in aviation-related industries. With its proximity to key roads and public transport access, Umm Ramool is one of the most desirable areas in the city.

Umm Ramool features a combination of residential apartments and commercial properties available for rent and sale. Residential units come in 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations ranging from 950 sq. ft. to 1,670 sq. ft., equipped with fitted kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and balconies. Commercial spaces include well-equipped office spaces, retail shops, and warehouses, many offering advanced security systems and 24-hour access.

Popular Buildings in Umm Ramool

These buildings are some of the most prominent in Umm Ramool, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, offering a mix of residential and commercial facilities. They cater to both professionals and families looking for quality living and working spaces in a well-connected area of the city.

  • Al Khazan Building: A low-rise commercial complex with office and retail space, central air-conditioning, parking, and 24-hour security.
  • Al Fattan Sky Towers: Two-tower residential complex offering 1 to 3-bedroom units along with retail podiums and wellness amenities.
  • Dubai CommerCity: A free zone dedicated to e-commerce, hosting logistics, business, and retail operations.

Renting a Property in Umm Ramool

The average rental price for a 1-bedroom apartment in Umm Ramool is AED 85,000, while a 2-bedroom unit typically rents for around AED 120,000. The area is particularly attractive to single professionals due to its proximity to numerous offices and convenient access to public transportation options.

Buying a Property in Umm Ramool

Currently, there are no residential properties listed for sale in Umm Ramool. However, the average price of commercial warehouses ranges between AED 4M and AED 10M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Umm Ramool, Dubai?

data.answer:
Umm Ramool Rashidiya offers a well-balanced lifestyle. While being a business-centric locality, it also offers a family-friendly environment with nurseries, parks, and gyms.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Umm Ramool

Most buildings in Umm Ramool provide dedicated parking, with smaller units typically allotted one space and larger units offering up to two. Visitor parking is generally available outside the buildings. 
Public transportation in the area is highly accessible, with major bus stops including Ramool Habtoor Motors, Dubai Festival City Bus Station, and Rebat Street Bus Stop. These stops are served by popular routes such as 32C and 44. Umm Ramool nearest metro stations to Umm Ramool offer connectivity to areas like Business Bay, Bur Dubai, and even Sharjah-bound destinations.

Supermarkets in and Around Umm Ramool

The community is well-served by several supermarkets that cater to a variety of grocery needs. Among the most popular options are Carryfood Supermarket, Abu Hail Supermarket, and New West Zone Supermarket, which are known for their wide product ranges. Smaller yet efficient stores like Sun and Moon Supermarket, Al Ain Food and Beverages, Algerian Fruits and Vegetable Supermarket, and Mohideen Supermarket also provide convenient daily shopping solutions for residents.

Shopping Malls Near Dubai Umm Ramool

Dubai Duty-Free Mall is the closest option for the residents of Umm Ramool, located right on Airport Road. A short 9-minute drive brings you to Dubai Festival City Mall, which features over 500 branded outlets and popular eateries. For an even larger shopping experience, Dubai Mall is just 12 minutes away and is one of the largest malls in the world.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Umm Ramool

Umm Ramool is home to several nurseries and schools that make it a convenient choice for families with children. Popular nurseries in the area include Mini Miracles and Mr Child Nursery, while Red Wood Montessori and Yellow Brick Road Nursery are just a short drive away in Al Garhoud. 

For primary and secondary education, families have access to reputable institutions such as Deira International School, Mazen School, Universal American School, and Al Khaleej National School. The Cambridge International School in Al Garhoud follows the British curriculum, and Indian curriculum options are available at Gulf Indian High School and Indian High School.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Umm Ramool

The area is home to several mosques such as Habib Mosque, Ibrahim Al Khalil Mosque, Bin Hamdan Mosque, and Al Rashidiya Al Kabeer Mosque, providing convenient places of worship for Muslim residents. 

Nearby areas like Al Jaddaf host a variety of churches including City Hill Dubai Church, Christian Fellowship Church, Saint Mary’s Church, Holy Trinity Church, and the Egyptian Coptic Church, all within a short driving distance. 

Hindu residents can access temples such as Ohm Malayilkada Munam Mughathu Kavu in Dubai Festival City, Lankaramya Temple, and the cluster of temples on Al Fahidi Street including Shiva Temple, ShrinathJi Temple, and Shree Krishna Haveli.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Umm Ramool

Residents of Umm Ramool can access outpatient services and general healthcare support at Prime Medical Centre, Dubai London Clinic, and Royal Wing Health Care Centre. For more advanced medical needs and emergency care, multi-specialty hospitals such as Mediclinic Welcare Hospital, Adam Vital Hospital, and Latifa Hospital are located nearby.

Location & Nearby Areas

Umm Ramool is located in eastern Dubai, near Dubai International Airport. It is bordered by major roads including Nad Al Hamar Road, Umm Ramool Street, and Al Ain Road. The community is surrounded by key residential areas such as Al Garhoud, Nad Shamma, and Al Rashidiya. 

Its prime location places it just 7 minutes away from Dubai Festival City and around 15 minutes from Business Bay and Dubai Creek Harbour.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Umm Ramool

data.answer:
Umm Ramool offers plenty of recreational and cultural experiences just minutes away. Residents can enjoy waterfront views, leisure attractions, and family-friendly venues close to home.

Restaurants

Umm Ramool is home to a variety of restaurants that cater to different tastes and dining preferences. For casual dining, options include Byblos Lebanese Restaurant, Al Barakah Restaurant, and Seashell Restaurant, each offering flavorful menus in a relaxed setting. 

Those seeking fine dining experiences can head to Le Méridien Dubai Hotel, just an 8-minute drive away, where high-end venues like Mustard, Beef Bistro, Casa Mia, and Bebemos serve a range of international cuisines. Other notable nearby options include Enigma, Paramount, Asha’s, and Tresind, all known for their upscale ambiance and innovative menus.

Beaches Near Umm Ramool

Al Mamzar Beach is just a 15-minute drive from Umm Ramool and offers a mix of water-based and land-based activities. Visitors can enjoy jet skiing and snorkelling in the calm waters or engage in recreational sports such as basketball, soccer, and football on the well-maintained courts and fields available along the beachfront.

Hotels Around Umm Ramool

Le Méridien Dubai Hotel & Conference Centre offers a luxurious stay with upscale rooms, a relaxing spa, and professional business facilities. Conveniently located near Umm Ramool, it is also home to several fine-dining restaurants serving international cuisine, making it a preferred choice for both leisure and business travellers.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Umm Ramool offers access to several nearby parks for outdoor recreation, including Nad Shamma Park, Marsa Al Khor Park, and Al Rashidiya Park. These green spaces provide opportunities for walking, relaxation, and family outings.

Fitness enthusiasts can stay active at gyms like Qualifier Gym on 19D Street, 971 Ladies Fitness Club on 5th Street, World Gym, and Al Raisi Gym on Nad Al Hamar Road. These facilities are equipped with modern equipment and offer various fitness programs.

Beauty and wellness services are also readily available in the area. Residents can visit salons such as Grand Flora Salon, Purple Oyster Ladies Beauty Salon, Flair Beauty Salon, Trendy Ladies Salon, and Tips and Toes for personal grooming and pampering experiences.

Community Events

Most events take place in Dubai Festival City, just minutes away. Residents of Umm Ramool often participate in its vibrant community activities.

Attractions and Landmarks

Dubai Creek Harbour is a popular waterfront destination just 9 minutes from Umm Ramool, offering scenic views, a yacht club, and an international golf course. It’s ideal for those looking to enjoy upscale leisure activities by the water.

Another highlight is the Dubai Dolphinarium, located just 12 minutes away. This indoor marine attraction is perfect for families, featuring entertaining dolphin and seal shows as well as interactive educational experiences for children.

Residents also have quick access to Dubai Festival City, which offers a mix of entertainment, dining, and retail options, adding to the appeal of Umm Ramool’s location.

Umm Ramool is primarily a rental-focused community, offering a wide variety of residential and commercial options that cater to professionals and businesses alike. Its close proximity to Dubai International Airport also enhances connectivity and convenience for frequent travellers and aviation professionals.

Is Umm Ramool good for professionals? 

Yes, due to its proximity to commercial zones and public transport.

Are apartments available for sale in Umm Ramool? 

No, only commercial properties like warehouses are available for purchase.

What is the nearest metro station to Umm Ramool? 

There are several metro and bus stations nearby, including Dubai Festival City and Ramool Habtoor Motors stops.

data.content:
Umm Ramool, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is a strategically located mixed-use community on the eastern side of the city. Bordering major roads such as Nad Al Hamar Road (D62), Airport Road (D89), and Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Ramool offers quick access to major hubs like Dubai Festival City, Garhoud, and the Jaddaf Waterfront. Its location right next to Dubai International Airport makes it a top choice for professionals and particularly convenient for Emirates Airlines staff.

The area is a dynamic blend of residential and commercial zones, featuring mid- to high-rise buildings with apartments, offices, shops, and warehouses. This makes Dubai Umm Ramool a prime location for individuals and singles looking to live close to their workplace. With well-connected transport routes and proximity to a metro station near Umm Ramool, public transportation is highly accessible.

The area has grown into a sought-after neighborhood with a full range of urban amenities. From family-friendly apartments and top-rated schools to nearby supermarkets, clinics, fitness centers and leisure attractions, Umm Ramool, Dubai, is more than just a transit hub, it's a thriving community where residents can live, work, and enjoy a vibrant lifestyle.
